title: Zesty Middle Eastern Halloumi Cheese Flatbread
description: A peppery and flavorful lacto-vegetarian dish featuring halloumi cheese, perfect for a solo dinner, with a cheese-pull effect and a hint of cooking wine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together cooking wine, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper to emulsify the sauce.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Arrange the sliced halloumi cheese on top of the flatbread, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the emulsified sauce evenly over the halloumi cheese.
Sprinkle chopped fresh parsley and mint over the cheese.
Drizzle lemon juice over the top of the flatbread.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes before slicing and serving.
